Ant Laudes.ant: Lætáre, * Virgo Mater; surréxit Christus de sepúlcro.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother, * Christ is risen from the grave.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ascéndit Deus * in jubilatióne, et Dóminus in voce tubæ.
Ant Laudes.antEng: God is gone up with a shout, * and the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

Ant Laudes.ant: Spíritus Dómini * replévit orbem terrárum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The spirit of the Lord * hath filled the world.

Ant Laudes.ant: Assúmpta est * María in cælum: gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary hath been taken to heaven. * The angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exaltáta est * Virgo María super choros Angelórum, et in cápite ejus coróna stellárum duódecim.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Virgin Mary * hath been exalted over choirs of angels, and upon her head there is a crown of twelve stars.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Angelus Gábriel * nuntiávit Maríæ: et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel * announced unto Mary, and she conceived by the Holy Ghost.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Intrávit María * in domum Zacharíæ, et salutávit Elísabeth.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Mary entered * into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elizabeth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Péperit Fílium suum * primogénitum, et reclinávit eum in præsépio.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: She brought forth her first-born Son, * and laid Him in a manger.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cum indúcerent * Jesum paréntes ejus, ut sísterent eum Dómino, Símeon accépit eum in ulnas suas, et benedíxit Deum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His parents brought in * (the child) Jesus to present Him to the Lord, Simeon took Him up in his arms and blessed God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Requiréntes Jesum * paréntes ejus, invenérunt illum post tríduum in médio doctórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: His parents seeking Jesus * found Him after three days in the midst of the doctors.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Cœpit contristári, * et factus est sudor ejus in horto sicut guttæ sánguinis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He began to be very sorrowful, * and in the garden the sweat became as it were drops of blood.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Apprehéndit * Pilátus Jesum, et flagellávit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Pilate took Jesus * and scourged Him.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mílites plecténtes corónam * de spinis, imposuérunt super caput ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The soldiers plaited a crown * of thorns, and put it on His Head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Crucis impérium * super húmerum ejus: regnávit a ligno Deus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The government was upon His shoulder, * even the cross; from the tree hath God reigned.

Ant Vespera.ant: Quæ est ista, * speciósa sicut colúmba, quasi rosa plantáta super rivos aquárum?
Ant Vespera.antEng: Who is this, * fair as a dove, like a rose-tree planted beside the rivers of waters?

Ant Vespera.ant: Virgo potens, * sicut turris David: mille clípei pendent ex ea, omnis armatúra fórtium.
Ant Vespera.antEng: A virgin most mighty, * like the tower of David, whereon there hung a thousand bucklers, all the shields of valiant men.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Hail Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee, blessed art thou among women.

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedíxit te Dóminus * in virtúte sua, quia per te ad níhilum redégit inimícos nostros.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord hath blessed thee * by His power, because through thee He hath brought our enemies to nought.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vidérunt eam * fíliæ Sion vernántem in flóribus rosárum, et beatíssimam prædicavérunt.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The daughters of Sion saw her in her spring time, amidst the flowers of the roses, and called her most blessed.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Dabit illi * Dóminus Deus sedem David, patris ejus: et regnábit in domo Jacob in ætérnum, et regni ejus non erit finis, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: The Lord God * shall give unto him the throne of David, his father: and he shall reign in the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there shall be no end, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Fecit nos Deo * et Patri suo regnum, primogénitus mortuórum, et Princeps regum terræ, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: He hath made us * a kingdom to God and his Father: the first begotten of the dead, and the Prince of the kings of the earth, alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Habet in vestiménto * et in fémore suo scriptum: Rex regum, et Dóminus dominántium. Ipsi glória et impérium, in sǽcula sæculórum.
Ant 3.eng: And he hath on his garment, * and on his thigh written: King of kings, and Lord of lords. To him be glory and empire for ever and ever.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Fratres: Grátias ágimus Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctórum in lúmine, qui erípuit nos de potestáte tenebrárum, et tránstulit in regnum Fílii dilectiónis suæ.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Brethren: We give thanks to God the Father, who hath made us worthy to be partakers of the lot of the saints in light, who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In ipso complácuit omnem plenitúdinem inhabitáre, et per eum reconciliáre ómnia in ipsum, pacíficans per sánguinem crucis ejus sive quæ in terris, sive quæ in cælis sunt, in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro.
Capitulum Nona.eng: In him, it hath well pleased the Father, that all fullness should dwell, and through him to reconcile all things unto himself, making peace through the blood of his cross, both as to the things that are on earth, and the things that are in heaven, in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Omnia per ipsum et in ipso creáta sunt, et ipse est ante omnes, et ómnia in ipso constant. Et ipse est caput córporis Ecclésiæ, qui est princípium, primogénitus ex mórtuis, ut sit in ómnibus ipse primátum tenens.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: LL things were created by him and in him, and he is before all, and by him all things consist. And he is the head of the body, the Church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he may hold the primacy.

Doxology.lat:
Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui sceptra mundi témperas,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Vexílla Christus ínclita
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Vexílla Christus ínclita
Late triúmphans éxplicat:
Gentes adéste súpplices,
Regíque regum pláudite.

Non Ille regna cládibus:
Non vi metúque súbdidit
Alto levátus stípite,
Amóre traxit ómnia.

O ter beáta cívitas
Cui rite Christus ímperat,
Quæ jussa pergit éxsequi
Edícta mundo cǽlitus!

Non arma flagrant ímpia,
Pax usque firmat fœ́dera,
Arrídet et concórdia,
Tutus stat ordo cívicus.

Servat fides connúbia,
Juvénta pubet íntegra,
Pudíca florent límina
Domésticis virtútibus.

Optáta nobis spléndeat
Lux ista, Rex dulcíssime:
Te, pace adépta cándida,
Adóret orbis súbditus.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui sceptra mundi témperas,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Christ’s flag unfurled in glory raised,
Triumphing o’er the serpent’s stings;
Come humbly forward all ye lands,
Applauding the great King of kings.

No force or threat doth he need use,
Not by coersion leadeth he;
Raised on the cross he draweth all,
With love unto his fruitful tree.

O! Thrice blest city of the Lord,
Wherein Christ ruleth without dearth;
Fervently she doth execute
His heavenly edicts to the earth,

No fiery weapon can e’er harm,
The peace ’stablished by Jesus’ hand;
In happiness and unity,
The ranks of Christ secure do stand.

A marriage blessed by faith in thee,
Yields virtuous offspring from the womb;
Like seed in fertile soil doth grow,
In virtuous homes do children bloom.

We yearn and long to shine on us,
Thy light, O sweet and winsome King;
All thus submitted to thy reign,
To us, thy gift of peace do bring.

All glory be, Jesu, to thee,
Thy scepter over all that be;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Ætérna Imago Altíssimi
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Ætérna Imago Altíssimi,
Lumen, Deus, de Lúmine,
Tibi, Redémptor glória,
Honor, potéstas régia.

Tu solus ante sǽcula
Spes atque centrum témporum,
Cui jure sceptrum géntium
Pater suprémum crédidit.

Tu flos pudícæ Vírginis,
Nostræ caput propáginis,
Lapis cadúcus vértice
Ac mole terras óccupans.

Diro tyránno súbdita,
Damnáta stirps mortálium,
Per te refrégit víncula
Sibíque cælum víndicat.

Doctor, Sacérdos, Légifer
Præfers notátum sánguine
In veste « Princeps príncipum
Regúmque Rex Altíssimus ».

Tibi voléntes súbdimur,
Qui jure cunctis ímperas:
Hæc cívium beátitas
Tuis subésse légibus.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui sceptra mundi témperas,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
O thou eternal Image bright
Of God most high, thou Light of Light,
To thee, Redeemer, glory be,
And might and kingly majesty.

Sole hope of all created things,
Thou art the Lord and King of kings,
Whom God, long ere creation's morn,
Had crowned to rule earth yet unborn.

Fair flower from the Virgin's breast,
Our race's Head for ever blest,
The stone that Daniel saw on high,
Which falling, o'er the world doth lie.

The race of men, condemned to lie
Beneath the direful tyrant's yoke,
By thee at length the shackles broke
And claimed the fatherland on high.

Priest, Teacher, Giver of the law,
Thy Name the rapt Apostle saw
Writ on thy vesture and thy thigh:
The King Of Kings, The Lord Most High.

Fain would we own thy blessed sway,
Whose rule all creatures must obey;
For happy is that state and throne
Whose subjects seek thy will alone.

All glory be, Jesu, to thee,
Thy scepter over all that be;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Te sæculórum Príncipem
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Te sæculórum Príncipem,
Te, Christe, Regem géntium,
Te méntium, te córdium
Unum fatémur árbitrum.

Scelésta turba clámitat:
Regnáre Christum nólumus:
Te nos ovántes ómnium
Regem suprémum dícimus.

O Christe, Princeps Pácifer,
Mentes rebélles súbice:
Tuóque amóre dévios,
Ovíle in unum cóngrega.

Ad hoc cruénta ab árbore
Pendes apértis brácchiis,
Diráque fossum cúspide
Cor igne flagrans éxhibes.

Ad hoc in aris ábderis
Vini dapísque imágine,
Fundens salútem fíliis
Transverberáto péctore.

Te natiónum Prǽsides
Honóre tollant público,
Colant magístri, júdices,
Leges et artes éxprimant.

Submíssa regum fúlgeant
Tibi dicáta insígnia:
Mitíque sceptro pátriam
Domósque subde cívium.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui sceptra mundi témperas,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
To thee, O Prince of all that be,
Thou Christ, O King eternally;
O Framer of the mind and heart,
Our one true Judge we say thou art.

The wicked protest, wail and cry,
Christ Jesus’ reign they would deny;
Rejoice we at thy glorious name,
Thou Highest King we do proclaim.

O Christ! The Source of all our peace,
Make all our sinful thoughts to cease;
And still in us our loves misplaced,
As Thy one sheepfold be we embraced.

For this, hanging on cruel tree,
With arms outstretched, for all to see;
His heart is pierced by soldier’s spear,
Revealing burning love most dear.

From this the altar of the tree
Thy blood flows forth from Calvary;
As wine to us it doth appear,
To thine own heart it draws us near.

Thou Governor of all that be,
May all thy creatures honour thee;
All those who rule, O Lord renew!
Source of all precepts just and true.

To regal glory, all submit,
All crowns and honours we do remit;—
To thy scepter—so sweet and mild!
Submit we as a little child.

All glory be, Jesu, to thee,
Thy scepter over all that be;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Jesum Christum, Regem regum: * Veníte adorémus.
Invit.eng: Jesus Christ, the King of kings * Come, let us adore!

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: In ipso complácuit omnem plenitúdinem inhabitáre, et per eum reconciliáre ómnia in ipsum, pacíficans per sánguinem crucis ejus sive quæ in terris, sive quæ in cælis sunt, in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro.
Lectio Prima.eng: In him, it hath well pleased the Father, that all fullness should dwell, and through him to reconcile all things unto himself, making peace through the blood of his cross, both as to the things that are on earth, and the things that are in heaven, in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Nocturn 1 Versum.eng: ℣. Given to me is all power.
Nocturn 1 Versum.engR: ℟. In heaven and in earth.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.lat: ℣. Afférte Dómino, famíliæ populórum.
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. Bring ye to the Lord, O ye families of the nations.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. Bring ye to the Lord glory and empire.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.latR: ℟. Omnes gentes sérvient ei.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. They shall adore him: all kings of the earth.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. All nations shall serve him.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in dilécto Fílio tuo, universórum Rege, ómnia instauráre voluísti: concéde propítius; ut cunctæ famíliæ géntium, peccáti vúlnere disgregátæ, ejus suavíssimo subdántur império:
Oratio.eng: Almighty and everlasting God, who in thy beloved Son, the King of the whole world, hast willed to restore all things: mercifully grant that all the families of nations, now kept apart by the wound of sin, may be brought under the sweet yoke of his rule.

℣. All nations shall serve him.

Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Afférte Dómino, * Famíliæ populórum.

℟. O ye families of the nations.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Bring ye to the Lord, * O ye families of the nations.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve

Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.

Ant Laudes.ant: Suscitábit * Deus cæli regnum quod commínuet et consúmet univérsa regna, et ipsum stabit in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The God of heaven * will set up a kingdom that shall break in pieces and shall consume all these kingdoms, and itself shall stand for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dedit ei Dóminus * potestátem et honórem et regnum; et omnes pópuli, tribus et linguæ ipsi sérvient.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord gave him * power and glory, and a kingdom; and all peoples, tribes and tongues shall serve him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exíbunt aquæ vivæ * de Jerúsalem; et erit Dóminus Rex super omnem terram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Living waters shall go out * from Jerusalem; and the Lord shall be king over all the earth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Magnificábitur * usque ad términos terræ, et erit iste pax.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Now shall he be magnified * even to the ends of the earth, and this man shall be our peace.

Ant Laudes.ant: Gens et regnum * quod non servíerit tibi, períbit: et gentes solitúdine vastabúntur.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The nation and the kingdom * that will not serve thee, shall perish: and the Gentiles shall be wasted with desolation.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ego autem * constitútus sum Rex ab eo super Sion montem sanctum ejus, prǽdicans præcéptum ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I have been set up * as King by Him on Sion, His holy mountain, proclaiming His decree.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Glória * et honóre coronásti eum, Dómine: ómnia subjecísti sub pédibus ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast crowned him * with glory and honor, O Lord, putting all things under His feet.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Elevámini, * portæ æternáles, et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Reach up * you ancient portals, that the King of glory may come in.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sedébit * Dóminus Rex in ætérnum: Dóminus benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord is enthroned * as King forever; may the Lord bless his people with peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Virga directiónis, * virga regni tui: proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: A tempered rod * is thy royal scepter; therefore shall nations praise thee forever and ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Psállite * Regi nostro, psállite: quóniam Rex magnus super omnem terram.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing praise to our King * sing praise; for he is the great King over all earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedicéntur in ipso * omnes tribus terræ; omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In Him * shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed; all the nations shall proclaim His greatness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et ego primogénitum * ponam illum: excélsum præ régibus terræ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: And I will make Him * the firstborn, highest of the kings of the earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Thronus ejus * sicut sol in conspéctu meo: et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: His throne * shall be like the sun before Me; like the moon, which remains forever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Pacíficus * vocábitur, et thronus ejus erit firmíssimus in perpétuum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: He shall be called * Peaceable, and his throne shall be most firm for ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Regnum ejus * regnum sempitérnum est, et omnes reges sérvient ei et obédient.
Ant Vespera.antEng: His kingdom * is an everlasting kingdom, and all kings shall serve him, and shall obey him.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce Vir Oriens * nomen ejus: sedébit et dominábitur, et loquétur pacem géntibus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold a man, the Orient * is his name: he shall sit and rule, and shall speak peace to the Gentiles.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dóminus * judex noster, Dóminus légifer noster: Dóminus Rex noster, ipse salvábit nos.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord * is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver: the Lord is our king, he will save us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce dedi te * in lucem géntium, ut sis salus mea usque ad extrémum terræ.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold, I have given thee * to be the light of the Gentiles, that thou mayst be my salvation even to the farthest part of the earth.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Dabit illi * Dóminus Deus sedem David, patris ejus: et regnábit in domo Jacob in ætérnum, et regni ejus non erit finis, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: The Lord God * shall give unto him the throne of David, his father: and he shall reign in the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there shall be no end, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Fecit nos Deo * et Patri suo regnum, primogénitus mortuórum, et Princeps regum terræ, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: He hath made us * a kingdom to God and his Father: the first begotten of the dead, and the Prince of the kings of the earth, alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Habet in vestiménto * et in fémore suo scriptum: Rex regum, et Dóminus dominántium. Ipsi glória et impérium, in sǽcula sæculórum.
Ant 3.eng: And he hath on his garment, * and on his thigh written: King of kings, and Lord of lords. To him be glory and empire for ever and ever.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Fratres: Grátias ágimus Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctórum in lúmine, qui erípuit nos de potestáte tenebrárum, et tránstulit in regnum Fílii dilectiónis suæ.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Brethren: We give thanks to God the Father, who hath made us worthy to be partakers of the lot of the saints in light, who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In ipso complácuit omnem plenitúdinem inhabitáre, et per eum reconciliáre ómnia in ipsum, pacíficans per sánguinem crucis ejus sive quæ in terris, sive quæ in cælis sunt, in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro.
Capitulum Nona.eng: In him, it hath well pleased the Father, that all fullness should dwell, and through him to reconcile all things unto himself, making peace through the blood of his cross, both as to the things that are on earth, and the things that are in heaven, in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Omnia per ipsum et in ipso creáta sunt, et ipse est ante omnes, et ómnia in ipso constant. Et ipse est caput córporis Ecclésiæ, qui est princípium, primogénitus ex mórtuis, ut sit in ómnibus ipse primátum tenens.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: LL things were created by him and in him, and he is before all, and by him all things consist. And he is the head of the body, the Church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he may hold the primacy.

Qui sceptra mundi témperas,

Amen.

Hymnus Laudes.title: Vexílla Christus ínclita
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Vexílla Christus ínclita
Late triúmphans éxplicat:
Gentes adéste súpplices,
Regíque regum pláudite.

Non Ille regna cládibus:
Non vi metúque súbdidit
Alto levátus stípite,
Amóre traxit ómnia.

O ter beáta cívitas
Cui rite Christus ímperat,
Quæ jussa pergit éxsequi
Edícta mundo cǽlitus!

Non arma flagrant ímpia,
Pax usque firmat fœ́dera,
Arrídet et concórdia,
Tutus stat ordo cívicus.

Servat fides connúbia,
Juvénta pubet íntegra,
Pudíca florent límina
Domésticis virtútibus.

Optáta nobis spléndeat
Lux ista, Rex dulcíssime:
Te, pace adépta cándida,
Adóret orbis súbditus.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui sceptra mundi témperas,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.

womb;

Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Jesum Christum, Regem regum: * Veníte adorémus.
Invit.eng: Jesus Christ, the King of kings * Come, let us adore!

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: In ipso complácuit omnem plenitúdinem inhabitáre, et per eum reconciliáre ómnia in ipsum, pacíficans per sánguinem crucis ejus sive quæ in terris, sive quæ in cælis sunt, in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro.
Lectio Prima.eng: In him, it hath well pleased the Father, that all fullness should dwell, and through him to reconcile all things unto himself, making peace through the blood of his cross, both as to the things that are on earth, and the things that are in heaven, in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Nocturn 1 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 1 Versum.eng: ℣. Given to me is all power.
Nocturn 1 Versum.engR: ℟. In heaven and in earth.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.lat: ℣. Afférte Dómino, famíliæ populórum.
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. Bring ye to the Lord, O ye families of the nations.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. Bring ye to the Lord glory and empire.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.latR: ℟. Omnes gentes sérvient ei.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. They shall adore him: all kings of the earth.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. All nations shall serve him.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in dilécto Fílio tuo, universórum Rege, ómnia instauráre voluísti: concéde propítius; ut cunctæ famíliæ géntium, peccáti vúlnere disgregátæ, ejus suavíssimo subdántur império:
Oratio.eng: Almighty and everlasting God, who in thy beloved Son, the King of the whole world, hast willed to restore all things: mercifully grant that all the families of nations, now kept apart by the wound of sin, may be brought under the sweet yoke of his rule.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Adorábunt eum * Omnes reges terræ.
℣. Omnes gentes sérvient ei.
℟. Omnes reges terræ.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Adorábunt eum * Omnes reges terræ.

℟.br. They shall adore him: * All kings of the earth.
℣. All nations shall serve him.
℟. All kings of the earth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. They shall adore him: * All kings of the earth.

℟. Famíliæ populórum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Afférte Dómino, * Famíliæ populórum.

Ant Laudes.ant: Suscitábit * Deus cæli regnum quod commínuet et consúmet univérsa regna, et ipsum stabit in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The God of heaven * will set up a kingdom that shall break in pieces and shall consume all these kingdoms, and itself shall stand for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dedit ei Dóminus * potestátem et honórem et regnum; et omnes pópuli, tribus et linguæ ipsi sérvient.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord gave him * power and glory, and a kingdom; and all peoples, tribes and tongues shall serve him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exíbunt aquæ vivæ * de Jerúsalem; et erit Dóminus Rex super omnem terram.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Living waters shall go out * from Jerusalem; and the Lord shall be king over all the earth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Magnificábitur * usque ad términos terræ, et erit iste pax.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Now shall he be magnified * even to the ends of the earth, and this man shall be our peace.

Ant Laudes.ant: Gens et regnum * quod non servíerit tibi, períbit: et gentes solitúdine vastabúntur.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The nation and the kingdom * that will not serve thee, shall perish: and the Gentiles shall be wasted with desolation.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ego autem * constitútus sum Rex ab eo super Sion montem sanctum ejus, prǽdicans præcéptum ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I have been set up * as King by Him on Sion, His holy mountain, proclaiming His decree.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Glória * et honóre coronásti eum, Dómine: ómnia subjecísti sub pédibus ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast crowned him * with glory and honor, O Lord, putting all things under His feet.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Elevámini, * portæ æternáles, et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Reach up * you ancient portals, that the King of glory may come in.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sedébit * Dóminus Rex in ætérnum: Dóminus benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
Virga directiónis, * virga regni tui: proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: R. In heaven and on earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Psállite * Regi nostro, psállite: quóniam Rex magnus super omnem terram.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord is enthroned * as King forever; may the Lord bless his people with peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedicéntur in ipso * omnes tribus terræ; omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: A tempered rod * is thy royal scepter; therefore shall nations praise thee forever and ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Et ego primogénitum * ponam illum: excélsum præ régibus terræ.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing praise to our King * sing praise; for he is the great King over all earth.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Thronus ejus * sicut sol in conspéctu meo: et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum.

Ant Vespera.ant: Pacíficus * vocábitur, et thronus ejus erit firmíssimus in perpétuum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: He shall be called * Peaceable, and his throne shall be most firm for ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Regnum ejus * regnum sempitérnum est, et omnes reges sérvient ei et obédient.
Ant Vespera.antEng: His kingdom * is an everlasting kingdom, and all kings shall serve him, and shall obey him.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce Vir Oriens * nomen ejus: sedébit et dominábitur, et loquétur pacem géntibus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold a man, the Orient * is his name: he shall sit and rule, and shall speak peace to the Gentiles.

Ant Vespera.ant: Dóminus * judex noster, Dóminus légifer noster: Dóminus Rex noster, ipse salvábit nos.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord * is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver: the Lord is our king, he will save us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce dedi te * in lucem géntium, ut sis salus mea usque ad extrémum terræ.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold, I have given thee * to be the light of the Gentiles, that thou mayst be my salvation even to the farthest part of the earth.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Ángeli, * Archángeli, Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, Chérubim atque Séraphim, Patriárchæ et Prophétæ, sancti legis Doctóres, Apóstoli, omnes Christi Mártyres, sancti Confessóres, Vírgines Dómini, Anachorítæ, Sanctíque omnes, intercédite pro nobis.
Ant 1.eng: O ye Angels, * ye Archangels, ye Thrones and Dominions, ye Principalities and Powers, ye mighty ones of the heavens, ye Cherubim and Seraphim, O ye Patriarchs and Prophets, ye holy Teachers of the Law, O ye Apostles, O all ye Martyrs of Christ, ye holy Confessors, ye Virgins of the Lord, ye Hermits, O all ye holy children of God, make intercession for us.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus, te Prophetárum laudábilis númerus, te Mártyrum candidátus laudat exércitus, te omnes Sancti et elécti voce confiténtur unánimes, beáta Trínitas, unus Deus.
Ant 2.eng: The glorious company of the Apostles praise thee. * The goodly fellowship of the Prophets praise thee. The white-robed army of Martyrs praise thee. All thy Saints and Elect with one voice do acknowledge thee, O Blessed Trinity, One God!

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: O quam gloriósum est regnum * in quo cum Christo gaudent omnes Sancti, amícti stolis albis sequúntur Agnum quocúmque íerit!
Ant 3.eng: Oh! how glorious is the kingdom * where all the Saints rejoice with Christ; clothed in white robes, they follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth!

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce ego Joánnes vidi álterum Angelum ascendéntem ab ortu solis, habéntem signum Dei vivi: et clamávit voce magna quátuor Ángelis, quibus datum est nocére terræ et mari, dicens: Nolíte nocére terræ et mari, neque arbóribus, quoadúsque signémus servos Dei nostri in fróntibus eórum.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: And I, John, saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the sign of the living God; and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea, saying: Hurt not the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, till we sign the servants of our God in their foreheads.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Capitulum Nona.eng: Saying: Amen. Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Post hæc vidi turbam magnam, quam dinumeráre nemo póterat ex ómnibus géntibus, et tríbubus, et pópulis, et linguis, stantes ante thronum Dei, in conspéctu Agni, amícti stolis albis, et palmæ in mánibus eórum.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: After this I saw a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and tribes, and peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne, and in sight of the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Salútis ætérnæ dator
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Salútis ætérnæ dator,
Jesu, redémptis súbveni:
Virgo, Parens cleméntiæ
Dona salútem sérvulis.

Vos, Angelórum míllia,
Patrúmque cœtus, ágmina
Canóra Vatum; vos, reis
Precámini indulgéntiam.

Baptísta Christi prǽvius,
Summíque cæli Cláviger,
Cum céteris Apóstolis
Nexus resólvant críminum.

Cohors triúmphans Mártyrum,
Almus Sacerdótum chorus,
Et virginális cástitas
Nostros reátus ábluant.

Quicúmque in alta síderum
Regnátis aula príncipes,
Favéte votis súpplicum,
Qui dona cæli flágitant.

Virtus, honor, laus, glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Giver of life, eternal Lord!
thy own redeemed defend;
Mother of grace! thy children save,
And help them to the end.

Ye thousand thousand angel hosts!
Assist us in our need;
Ye patriarchs! with the prophet choir!
For our forgiveness plead.

Forerunner blest! and thou who still
Dost heaven's dread keys retain!
Ye glorious Apostles all!
Unloose our guilty chain.

Army of martyrs! holy priests
In beautiful array!
Ye happy troops of virgins chaste!
Wash all our stains away.

All ye who high above the stars
In heavenly glory reign!
May we through your prevailing prayers
Unto your joys attain.

Praise, honour, to the Father be,
Praise to his only Son;
Praise, Holy Paraclete, to thee,
While endless ages run.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Placáre, Christe, sérvulis
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Placáre, Christe, sérvulis,
Quibus Patris cleméntiam
Tuæ ad tribúnal grátiæ
Patróna Virgo póstulat.

Et vos beáta, per novem
Distíncta gyros ágmina,
Antíqua cum præséntibus,
Futúra damna péllite.

Apóstoli cum Vátibus,
Apud sevérum Júdicem,
Veris reórum flétibus
Expóscite indulgéntiam.

Vos, purpuráti mártyres,
Vos candidáti prǽmio
Confessiónis, éxsules
Vocáte nos in pátriam.

Choréa casta vírginum,
Et quos erémus íncolas
Transmísit astris, cǽlitum
Locáte nos in sédibus.

Auférte gentem pérfidam
Credéntium de fínibus,
Ut unus omnes únicum
Ovíle nos Pastor regat.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Natóque Patris único,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
O Christ, thy guilty people spare!
Lo, kneeling at thy gracious throne,
thy Virgin-Mother pours her prayer,
Imploring pardon for her own.

Ye angels, happy evermore!
Who in your circles nine ascend,
As ye have guarded us before,
So still from harm our steps defend.

Ye prophets and Apostles high!
Behold our penitential tears;
And plead for us when death is nigh,
our all-searching judge appears.

Ye martyrs all! a purple band,
And confessors, a white-robed train;
Oh, call us to our native land,
From this our exile, back again.

And ye, O choirs of virgins chaste!
Receive us to your seats on high;
With hermits whom the desert waste
Sent up of old into the sky.

Drive from the flock, O Spirit blest!
The false and faithless race away;
That all within one fold may rest,
Secure beneath one shepherd's sway.

To God the Father glory be,
And to his sole-begotten Son;
And glory, Holy Ghost, to thee,
While everlasting ages run.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Regem regum Dóminum veníte adorémus: * Quia ipse est coróna Sanctórum ómnium.
Invit.eng: O come, let us worship the Lord, the King of kings, * for He is Himself the Crown of all the Saints.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Lectio Prima.eng: Saying: Amen. Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus; ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam, multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris.
Oratio.eng: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Thy Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech Thee, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Thy mercy for which we yearn.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vidi turbam magnam, * quam dinumeráre nemo póterat, ex ómnibus géntibus, stantes ante thronum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I beheld, and, lo, great multitude, which no man could number, * of all nations, (and kindreds, and people, and tongues,) stood before the throne.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et omnes Ángeli * stabant in circúitu throni, et cecidérunt in conspéctu throni in fácies suas, et adoravérunt Deum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And all the Angels stood round about the throne, * (and about the Elders, and the four living creatures,) and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Redemísti nos, * Dómine Deus, in sánguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne, et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou, O Lord God, hast redeemed us by thy Blood, * out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation, and hast made us a kingdom unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícite Dóminum * omnes elécti ejus: ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Bless the Lord, all ye His chosen, * keep holiday, and extol Him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hymnus * ómnibus Sanctis ejus: fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi: glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The praise of all His Saints, * even of the children of Israel, a people near unto Him; this honour have all His Saints.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Novit Dóminus * viam justórum, qui in lege ejus meditántur die ac nocte.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord knoweth the way of the righteous, * who in His Law do meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mirificávit * Dóminus Sanctos suos, et exaudívit eos clamántes ad se.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath set apart for Himself them that are holy, * and when they called, He hath heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Admirábile est * nomen tuum, Dómine: quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctos tuos, et constituísti eos super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: How excellent is thy Name, O Lord, Who hast crowned thy Saints with glory and honour, * and madest them to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * qui operáti sunt justítiam, habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo, et requiéscent in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They that work righteousness, * O Lord, even they, shall abide in thy tabernacle, and dwell in thy holy Hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hæc est generátio * quæréntium Dóminum, quæréntium fáciem Dei Jacob.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This is the generation of them that seek the Lord, * that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lætámini in Dómino, * et exsultáte justi, et gloriámini omnes recti corde.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous, * and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Timéte Dóminum * omnes Sancti ejus, quóniam nihil deest timéntibus eum: ecce óculi Dómini super justos, et aures ejus ad preces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O fear the Lord, all ye His Saints, * for there is no want to them that fear Him. Behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are open unto their cry.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, spes Sanctórum * et turris fortitúdinis eórum, dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum, et habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, Thou hast been a shelter for thy Saints, * a strong tower from the enemy. Thou hast given the heritage to those that fear thy Name, and they shall abide in thy tabernacle for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, * lætámini in Dómino, et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Ye that love the Lord, rejoice in the Lord, * and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vidi turbam magnam, * quam dinumeráre nemo póterat, ex ómnibus géntibus, stantes ante thronum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I beheld, and, lo, great multitude, which no man could number, * of all nations, (and kindreds, and people, and tongues,) stood before the throne.

Ant Vespera.ant: Et omnes Ángeli * stabant in circúitu throni, et cecidérunt in conspéctu throni in fácies suas, et adoravérunt Deum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: And all the Angels stood round about the throne, * (and about the Elders, and the four living creatures,) and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Redemísti nos, * Dómine Deus, in sánguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne, et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Thou, O Lord God, hast redeemed us by thy Blood, * out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation, and hast made us a kingdom unto our God.

Ant Vespera.ant: Benedícite Dóminum * omnes elécti ejus: ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Bless the Lord, all ye His chosen, * keep holiday, and extol Him.

Ant Vespera.ant: Hymnus * ómnibus Sanctis ejus: fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi: glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The praise of all His Saints, * even of the children of Israel, a people near unto Him; this honour have all His Saints.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Ángeli, * Archángeli, Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, Chérubim atque Séraphim, Patriárchæ et Prophétæ, sancti legis Doctóres, Apóstoli, omnes Christi Mártyres, sancti Confessóres, Vírgines Dómini, Anachorítæ, Sanctíque omnes, intercédite pro nobis.
Ant 1.eng: O ye Angels, * ye Archangels, ye Thrones and Dominions, ye Principalities and Powers, ye mighty ones of the heavens, ye Cherubim and Seraphim, O ye Patriarchs and Prophets, ye holy Teachers of the Law, O ye Apostles, O all ye Martyrs of Christ, ye holy Confessors, ye Virgins of the Lord, ye Hermits, O all ye holy children of God, make intercession for us.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus, te Prophetárum laudábilis númerus, te Mártyrum candidátus laudat exércitus, te omnes Sancti et elécti voce confiténtur unánimes, beáta Trínitas, unus Deus.
Ant 2.eng: The glorious company of the Apostles praise thee. * The goodly fellowship of the Prophets praise thee. The white-robed army of Martyrs praise thee. All thy Saints and Elect with one voice do acknowledge thee, O Blessed Trinity, One God!

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: O quam gloriósum est regnum * in quo cum Christo gaudent omnes Sancti, amícti stolis albis sequúntur Agnum quocúmque íerit!
Ant 3.eng: Oh! how glorious is the kingdom * where all the Saints rejoice with Christ; clothed in white robes, they follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth!

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce ego Joánnes vidi álterum Angelum ascendéntem ab ortu solis, habéntem signum Dei vivi: et clamávit voce magna quátuor Ángelis, quibus datum est nocére terræ et mari, dicens: Nolíte nocére terræ et mari, neque arbóribus, quoadúsque signémus servos Dei nostri in fróntibus eórum.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: And I, John, saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the sign of the living God; and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea, saying: Hurt not the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, till we sign the servants of our God in their foreheads.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Capitulum Nona.eng: Saying: Amen. Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Post hæc vidi turbam magnam, quam dinumeráre nemo póterat ex ómnibus géntibus, et tríbubus, et pópulis, et linguis, stantes ante thronum Dei, in conspéctu Agni, amícti stolis albis, et palmæ in mánibus eórum.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: After this I saw a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and tribes, and peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne, and in sight of the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Salútis ætérnæ dator
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Salútis ætérnæ dator,
Jesu, redémptis súbveni:
Virgo, Parens cleméntiæ
Dona salútem sérvulis.

Vos, Angelórum míllia,
Patrúmque cœtus, ágmina
Canóra Vatum; vos, reis
Precámini indulgéntiam.

Baptísta Christi prǽvius,
Summíque cæli Cláviger,
Cum céteris Apóstolis
Nexus resólvant críminum.

Cohors triúmphans Mártyrum,
Almus Sacerdótum chorus,
Et virginális cástitas
Nostros reátus ábluant.

Quicúmque in alta síderum
Regnátis aula príncipes,
Favéte votis súpplicum,
Qui dona cæli flágitant.

Virtus, honor, laus, glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Giver of life, eternal Lord!
thy own redeemed defend;
Mother of grace! thy children save,
And help them to the end.

Ye thousand thousand angel hosts!
Assist us in our need;
Ye patriarchs! with the prophet choir!
For our forgiveness plead.

Forerunner blest! and thou who still
Dost heaven's dread keys retain!
Ye glorious Apostles all!
Unloose our guilty chain.

Army of martyrs! holy priests
In beautiful array!
Ye happy troops of virgins chaste!
Wash all our stains away.

All ye who high above the stars
In heavenly glory reign!
May we through your prevailing prayers
Unto your joys attain.

Praise, honour, to the Father be,
Praise to his only Son;
Praise, Holy Paraclete, to thee,
While endless ages run.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Placáre, Christe, sérvulis
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Placáre, Christe, sérvulis,
Quibus Patris cleméntiam
Tuæ ad tribúnal grátiæ
Patróna Virgo póstulat.

Et vos beáta, per novem
Distíncta gyros ágmina,
Antíqua cum præséntibus,
Futúra damna péllite.

Apóstoli cum Vátibus,
Apud sevérum Júdicem,
Veris reórum flétibus
Expóscite indulgéntiam.

Vos, purpuráti mártyres,
Vos candidáti prǽmio
Confessiónis, éxsules
Vocáte nos in pátriam.

Choréa casta vírginum,
Et quos erémus íncolas
Transmísit astris, cǽlitum
Locáte nos in sédibus.

Auférte gentem pérfidam
Credéntium de fínibus,
Ut unus omnes únicum
Ovíle nos Pastor regat.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Natóque Patris único,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
O Christ, thy guilty people spare!
Lo, kneeling at thy gracious throne,
thy Virgin-Mother pours her prayer,
Imploring pardon for her own.

Ye angels, happy evermore!
Who in your circles nine ascend,
As ye have guarded us before,
So still from harm our steps defend.

Ye prophets and Apostles high!
Behold our penitential tears;
And plead for us when death is nigh,
our all-searching judge appears.

Ye martyrs all! a purple band,
And confessors, a white-robed train;
Oh, call us to our native land,
From this our exile, back again.

And ye, O choirs of virgins chaste!
Receive us to your seats on high;
With hermits whom the desert waste
Sent up of old into the sky.

Drive from the flock, O Spirit blest!
The false and faithless race away;
That all within one fold may rest,
Secure beneath one shepherd's sway.

To God the Father glory be,
And to his sole-begotten Son;
And glory, Holy Ghost, to thee,
While everlasting ages run.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Regem regum Dóminum veníte adorémus: * Quia ipse est coróna Sanctórum ómnium.
Invit.eng: O come, let us worship the Lord, the King of kings, * for He is Himself the Crown of all the Saints.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Lectio Prima.eng: Saying: Amen. Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus; ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam, multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris.
Oratio.eng: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Thy Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech Thee, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Thy mercy for which we yearn.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vidi turbam magnam, * quam dinumeráre nemo póterat, ex ómnibus géntibus, stantes ante thronum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I beheld, and, lo, great multitude, which no man could number, * of all nations, (and kindreds, and people, and tongues,) stood before the throne.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et omnes Ángeli * stabant in circúitu throni, et cecidérunt in conspéctu throni in fácies suas, et adoravérunt Deum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And all the Angels stood round about the throne, * (and about the Elders, and the four living creatures,) and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Redemísti nos, * Dómine Deus, in sánguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne, et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou, O Lord God, hast redeemed us by thy Blood, * out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation, and hast made us a kingdom unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícite Dóminum * omnes elécti ejus: ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Bless the Lord, all ye His chosen, * keep holiday, and extol Him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hymnus * ómnibus Sanctis ejus: fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi: glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The praise of all His Saints, * even of the children of Israel, a people near unto Him; this honour have all His Saints.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Novit Dóminus * viam justórum, qui in lege ejus meditántur die ac nocte.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord knoweth the way of the righteous, * who in His Law do meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mirificávit * Dóminus Sanctos suos, et exaudívit eos clamántes ad se.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath set apart for Himself them that are holy, * and when they called, He hath heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Admirábile est * nomen tuum, Dómine: quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctos tuos, et constituísti eos super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: How excellent is thy Name, O Lord, Who hast crowned thy Saints with glory and honour, * and madest them to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * qui operáti sunt justítiam, habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo, et requiéscent in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They that work righteousness, * O Lord, even they, shall abide in thy tabernacle, and dwell in thy holy Hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hæc est generátio * quæréntium Dóminum, quæréntium fáciem Dei Jacob.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This is the generation of them that seek the Lord, * that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lætámini in Dómino, * et exsultáte justi, et gloriámini omnes recti corde.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous, * and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Timéte Dóminum * omnes Sancti ejus, quóniam nihil deest timéntibus eum: ecce óculi Dómini super justos, et aures ejus ad preces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O fear the Lord, all ye His Saints, * for there is no want to them that fear Him. Behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are open unto their cry.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, spes Sanctórum * et turris fortitúdinis eórum, dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum, et habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, Thou hast been a shelter for thy Saints, * a strong tower from the enemy. Thou hast given the heritage to those that fear thy Name, and they shall abide in thy tabernacle for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, * lætámini in Dómino, et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Ye that love the Lord, rejoice in the Lord, * and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.

Natóque Patris único,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
O Christ, thy guilty people spare!
Lo, kneeling at thy gracious throne,
thy Virgin-Mother pours her prayer,
Imploring pardon for her own.

Ye angels, happy evermore!
Who in your circles nine ascend,
As ye have guarded us before,
So still from harm our steps defend.

Ye prophets and Apostles high!
Behold our penitential tears;
And plead for us when death is nigh,
our all-searching judge appears.

Ye martyrs all! a purple band,
And confessors, a white-robed train;
Oh, call us to our native land,
From this our exile, back again.

And ye, O choirs of virgins chaste!
Receive us to your seats on high;
With hermits whom the desert waste
Sent up of old into the sky.

Drive from the flock, O Spirit blest!
The false and faithless race away;
That all within one fold may rest,
Secure beneath one shepherd's sway.

To God the Father glory be,
And to his sole-begotten Son;
And glory, Holy Ghost, to thee,
While everlasting ages run.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Regem regum Dóminum veníte adorémus: * Quia ipse est coróna Sanctórum ómnium.
Invit.eng: O come, let us worship the Lord, the King of kings, * for He is Himself the Crown of all the Saints.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro, in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Lectio Prima.eng: Saying: Amen. Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus; ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam, multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris.
Oratio.eng: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Thy Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech Thee, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Thy mercy for which we yearn.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vidi turbam magnam, * quam dinumeráre nemo póterat, ex ómnibus géntibus, stantes ante thronum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I beheld, and, lo, great multitude, which no man could number, * of all nations, (and kindreds, and people, and tongues,) stood before the throne.

Ant Laudes.ant: Et omnes Ángeli * stabant in circúitu throni, et cecidérunt in conspéctu throni in fácies suas, et adoravérunt Deum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: And all the Angels stood round about the throne, * (and about the Elders, and the four living creatures,) and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Redemísti nos, * Dómine Deus, in sánguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne, et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thou, O Lord God, hast redeemed us by thy Blood, * out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation, and hast made us a kingdom unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícite Dóminum * omnes elécti ejus: ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Bless the Lord, all ye His chosen, * keep holiday, and extol Him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hymnus * ómnibus Sanctis ejus: fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi: glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The praise of all His Saints, * even of the children of Israel, a people near unto Him; this honour have all His Saints.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Novit Dóminus * viam justórum, qui in lege ejus meditántur die ac nocte.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord knoweth the way of the righteous, * who in His Law do meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Mirificávit * Dóminus Sanctos suos, et exaudívit eos clamántes ad se.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord hath set apart for Himself them that are holy, * and when they called, He hath heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Admirábile est * nomen tuum, Dómine: quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctos tuos, et constituísti eos super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: How excellent is thy Name, O Lord, Who hast crowned thy Saints with glory and honour, * and madest them to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * qui operáti sunt justítiam, habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo, et requiéscent in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They that work righteousness, * O Lord, even they, shall abide in thy tabernacle, and dwell in thy holy Hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hæc est generátio * quæréntium Dóminum, quæréntium fáciem Dei Jacob.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This is the generation of them that seek the Lord, * that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lætámini in Dómino, * et exsultáte justi, et gloriámini omnes recti corde.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous, * and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Timéte Dóminum * omnes Sancti ejus, quóniam nihil deest timéntibus eum: ecce óculi Dómini super justos, et aures ejus ad preces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O fear the Lord, all ye His Saints, * for there is no want to them that fear Him. Behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are open unto their cry.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, spes Sanctórum * et turris fortitúdinis eórum, dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum, et habitábunt in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, Thou hast been a shelter for thy Saints, * a strong tower from the enemy. Thou hast given the heritage to those that fear thy Name, and they shall abide in thy tabernacle for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, * lætámini in Dómino, et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Ye that love the Lord, rejoice in the Lord, * and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.

Oratio Matutinum.label: Oratio
Oratio Matutinum.lat: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur:
Oratio Matutinum.eng: O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Ecclésiam tuam, Dómine, sancti Cároli Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis contínua protectióne custódi: ut, sicut illum pastorális sollicitúdo gloriósum réddidit; ita nos ejus intercéssio in tuo semper fáciat amóre fervéntes.
Oratio.eng: O Lord, give unto thy Church for an unsleeping warder thine holy Confessor Bishop Charles; upon earth his carefulness did make him glorious as a shepherd, there where he is may his prayerfulness make him effectual as a bedesman, pleading with thee to make us to love thee more.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Vitális et Agrícolæ solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.
Oratio.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who keep the solemn memorial of thy blessed Martyrs Vitalis and Agricola, may find succour with thee in their prayers on our behalf.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui gloriósos Mártyres fortes in sua confessióne cognóvimus, pios apud te in nostra intercessióne sentiámus.
Oratio.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who know thy glorious witnesses to have been in their testifying leal toward thee, may feel, now that they are with thee, that they are in their prayers pitiful towards us.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui nos beáti Theodóri Mártyris tui confessióne gloriósa circúmdas et prótegis: præsta nobis ex ejus imitatióne profícere, et oratióne fulcíri.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who surround and protect us with the glorious profession of blessed Theodore, Your Martyr, grant us to profit by imitating him and to rejoice in his intercession.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui in corde beáti Andréæ Confessóris tui, per árduum cotídie in virtútibus proficiéndi votum, admirábiles ad te ascensiónes disposuísti: concéde nobis, ipsíus méritis et intercessióne, ita ejúsdem grátiæ partícipes fíeri; ut, perfectióra semper exsequéntes, ad glóriæ tuæ fastígium felíciter perducámur.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who didst make thy blessed Confessor Andrew to settle in his heart to go up wondrously toward thee by a stern vow daily to advance to the utmost of his power in godliness, grant unto us for the same thy servant's sake and at his prayers the like grace, so that we, seeking ever that which is more perfect, may happily attain the crown of thine everlasting glory.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Fac nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Tryphónis, Respícii et Nymphæ semper festa sectári: quorum suffrágiis, protectiónis tuæ dona sentiámus.
Oratio.eng: Make us, we beseech thee, O Lord, ever faithful to observe the feast-day of thy holy Martyrs, Tryphon, Respicius and Nympha, that through their prayers, we may enjoy the bounty of thy protection.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: O beátum virum, * cujus ánima paradísum póssidet! Unde exsúltant Ángeli, lætántur Archángeli, chorus Sanctórum proclámat, turba Vírginum invítat: Mane nobíscum in ætérnum.
Ant 1.eng: O how blessed a man is he! * His soul hath entered into possession in Paradise. There the Angels cry aloud for joy, there the Archangels make glad, there the whole company of the Saints do shout, there the army of the Virgins do call others to follow, (saying:) Make thine everlasting abode with us.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: O beátum virum, * cujus ánima paradísum póssidet! Unde exsúltant Ángeli, lætántur Archángeli, chorus Sanctórum proclámat, turba Vírginum invítat: Mane nobíscum in ætérnum.
Ant 2.eng: O how blessed a man is he! * His soul hath entered into possession in Paradise. There the Angels cry aloud for joy, there the Archangels make glad, there the whole company of the Saints do shout, there the army of the Virgins do call others to follow, (saying:) Make thine everlasting abode with us.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: O beátum Pontíficem, * qui totis viscéribus diligébat Christum Regem, et non formidábat impérii principátum! o sanctíssima ánima, quam etsi gládius persecutóris non ábstulit, palmam tamen martýrii non amísit!
Ant 3.eng: O how blessed a Bishop was he! * All his bowels yearned on the King Christ, and he had no dread for the power of the Empire! O how holy a soul was his, which passed not away by the sword of the persecutor, and yet lost not the palm of martyrdom.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Laudémus Deum nostrum * In confessióne beáti Martíni.
Invit.eng: For the testimony of blessed Martin, * let us praise our God.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui cónspicis, quia ex nulla nostra virtúte subsístimus: concéde propítius; ut, intercessióne beáti Martíni Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, contra ómnia advérsa muniámur.
Oratio.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that the worshipful Feast of thy blessed Confessor and Bishop Martin, may avail us to the increase both of godliness toward thee, and healthfulness to our own souls.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dixérunt discípuli * ad beátum Martínum: Cur nos, pater, déseris, aut cui nos desolátos relínquis? Invádent enim gregem tuum lupi rapáces.
Ant Laudes.antEng: His disciples said * unto Blessed Martin: Father, why wilt thou go away from us? or with whom wilt thou leave us orphans? For ravening wolves will break in upon thy flock.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dómine, * si adhuc pópulo tuo sum necessárius, non recúso labórem: fiat volúntas tua.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lord, if I be still needful to thy people, I refuse not * to work. thy will be done.

Ant Laudes.ant: O virum ineffábilem, * nec labóre victum, nec morte vincéndum, qui nec mori tímuit, nec vívere recusávit!
Ant Laudes.antEng: Not to be told is this man's glory; * whom work did not and death could not conquer; who neither feared to die, nor refused to live.

Ant Laudes.ant: Oculis ac mánibus * in cælum semper inténtus, invíctum ab oratióne spíritum non relaxábat, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: With eyes and hands lifted up to heaven, * he never let his mighty spirit slacken in prayer. Alleluia.

Ant Laudes.ant: Martínus * Ábrahæ sinu lætus excípitur: Martínus, hic pauper et módicus, cælum dives ingréditur, hymnis cæléstibus honorátur.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Martin is called joyfully into Abraham's bosom. * Martin, who was poor here and of small estimation, entereth rich into heaven, and the songs of heaven are raised in his honour.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Martínus, * adhuc catechúmenus, hac me veste contéxit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: While Martin * is yet a Catechumen, he hath clad Me in this garment.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctæ Trinitátis * fidem Martínus conféssus est, et baptísmi grátiam percépit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Martin * confessed the faith of the Holy Trinity, and received the grace of baptism.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ego signo crucis, * non clípeo protéctus, aut gálea, hóstium cúneos penetrábo secúrus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Not * in the shelter of a buckler, nor of an helmet, but with the sign of the Cross will I pierce the hosts of the enemy.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Confído in Dómino * quod fília mea, précibus tuis, reddénda sit sanitáti.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I trust * in the Lord that at thy prayers my daughter shall be healed.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tetrádius, * cógnita Dei virtúte, ad baptísmi grátiam pervénit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When Tetradius * knew the power of God, he attained unto the grace of baptism.

Ant Matutinum.ant: O ineffábilem virum, * per quem nobis tanta mirácula corúscant!
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Not to be told * is this man's glory, by whom so many wonderful works have been set forth before us!

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dóminus Jesus Christus, * non purpurátum aut diadémate reniténtem, se ventúrum esse prædíxit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord Jesus Christ * said not that He would come clothed in purple or adorned with a crown.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sacérdos Dei, Martíne, * apérti sunt tibi cæli et regnum Patris mei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Martin, * thou Priest of God, the heavens are open unto thee, yea, and the kingdom of My Father.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sacérdos Dei, Martíne, * pastor egrégie, ora pro nobis Deum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Martin, * thou Priest of God, thou worthy shepherd, pray God on our behalf.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dixérunt discípuli * ad beátum Martínum: Cur nos, pater, déseris, aut cui nos desolátos relínquis? Invádent enim gregem tuum lupi rapáces.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: His disciples said * unto Blessed Martin: Father, why wilt thou go away from us? or with whom wilt thou leave us orphans? For ravening wolves will break in upon thy flock.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dómine, * si adhuc pópulo tuo sum necessárius, non recúso labórem: fiat volúntas tua.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Lord, if I be still needful to thy people, I refuse not * to work. thy will be done.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: O virum ineffábilem, * nec labóre victum, nec morte vincéndum, qui nec mori tímuit, nec vívere recusávit!
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Not to be told is this man's glory; * whom work did not and death could not conquer; who neither feared to die, nor refused to live.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Oculis ac mánibus * in cælum semper inténtus, invíctum ab oratióne spíritum non relaxábat, allelúja.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: With eyes and hands lifted up to heaven, * he never let his mighty spirit slacken in prayer. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Martínus * Ábrahæ sinu lætus excípitur: Martínus, hic pauper et módicus, cælum dives ingréditur, hymnis cæléstibus honorátur.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: Martin is called joyfully into Abraham's bosom. * Martin, who was poor here and of small estimation, entereth rich into heaven, and the songs of heaven are raised in his honour.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beáti N. Mártyris tui natalítia cólimus, intercessióne ejus in tui nóminis amóre roborémur.
Oratio.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that we who celebrate the martyrdom of blessed N., through his intercession be strengthened in your love.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui dispositióne mirábili infírma mundi éligis, ut fórtia quæque confúndas: concéde propítius humilitáti nostræ; ut, piis beáti Dídaci Confessóris tui précibus, ad perénnem in cælis glóriam sublimári mereámur.
Oratio.eng: O Almighty and everlasting God, Who in thy wonderful ordinance dost choose the weak things of the world to bring to nought the things that are strong, mercifully grant unto us thine unworthy servants, at the kindly prayers of thy blessed Confessor Diego, worthily to attain unto everlasting glory in heaven.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Divína Jesu cáritas
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Divína Jesu cáritas,
Tu magna sola pérficis,
Quæ, vertis ipsas vírgines
In férvidos apóstolos.

Per te refúlsit ínclita
Francísca, spreto sǽculo,
Sexúque major glóriam
Dei per orbem prótulit.

Beáta Mater, réspice
Cælo benígna fílias,
Tuúmque fac virtútibus
Opus viréscat, flóreat:

Cor perge Jesu fléctere,
Stirpes ut omnes cóngreget
Et prona nobis ímpetra
Flammas amóris ǽmulas.

Virtus, honor, laus, glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio
Sancto simul Paráclito
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesus' love divine, theme worthy of all song,
To whom alone high deeds belong,
Causing e'en virgins on missions to go,
Their hearts all burning with th'apostles glow.

Through thee the renown of Frances did shine,
Despising the world in thy love to recline,
Transcending her sex, yea knowing no bound,
She extended God's glory all the world round.

O Blessed Mother from heaven above,
Regard here thy daughters with kindliest love,
Make flourish now thy good work below,
That virtue's blossoms we ever may know.

The heart of Jesus, we pray thee, sway,
For one flock 'mong nations, may he hasten the day,
And mindful of us, do thou obtain,
Like flames of love we may attain.

To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Spirit, Three in One,
Laud, honor, might and glory be
From age to age eternally.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Ex Corde Jesu cóncipit
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Ex Corde Jesu cóncipit
Francísca flammas, ímpete
Queis fide Christi ad éxtimas
Festínat oras núntia.

Quacúmque transit, íllico
Odóra spirant lília
Horrens et ante vépribus
Tellus virétis énitet.

Eam migrántes Itali,
Terras per omnes díditi
Sensére matrem, sédulam
Leváre curas éxulum.

Non ira bacchans ǽquorum
Nivósa nec cacúmina,
Plagæ vel æstu tórridæ
Fortem morántur féminam.

Virtus, honor, laus, glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio
Sancto simul Paráclito
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
From the heart of Jesus flames so strong,
Impel Christ's messenger, God-speed, along,
Ever so faithful to the call from on high,
To farthermost regions she hurriedly draws nigh.

She, wheresoe'er her footsteps tread,
The fragrance of lilies was sure to be spread,
O'ergrown with briars the earth's dreadful scene,
Her touch transforms to a smiling field green.

Emigrants from Italy far from home,
Scattered through all climes and left to roam,
See in her deeds a mother so dear
Eager to lighten life's burdens here.

This valiant woman nothing could stay,
Regions e'er so torrid could not hinder her way,
Neither the billows of the great raging deep,
Nor the snow-capped peaks ever so steep.

To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Spirit, Three in One,
Laud, honor, might and glory be
From age to age eternally.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Beáta cæli régia
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Beáta cæli régia
Lætis resúltet cántibus
Plausúque terra súbdita
Polis utrísque cónsonet.

Præcíncta nimbo glóriæ
Francísca, inhǽrens ímpigra
Xavérii vestígiis
Triúmphat inter Cǽlites.

Ætáte jam tenéllula
Amóre Jesum déperit
Ipsúmque volvit péctore
Inférre cunctis géntibus.

Vox ecce dia própulit
Nido colúmbam pátrio;
Fines ad orbis últimos
Frequénter ipso cónvolat.

Virtus, honor, laus, glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio
Sancto simul Paráclito
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Let the court of the blessed in heaven resound
With joyful melody all the year round,
Let the earth in subjection add its applause
From pole to pole in heaven's great cause.

Now Frances in triumph with the heavenly company,
In a nimbus of glory with joy for eternity,
Xavier as a model she ever revered,
Faithful in his footsteps she always adhered.

When but a child of tenderest age
With love for Jesus, burning so sage
In her breast she ponders being led to pine,
That all nations be brought to her love divine.

Lo! The voice of God disturbs her rest,
The dove must leave her homeland nest,
Again and again she wings her long flight
To world's farthest ends unperturbed by fright.

To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Spirit, Three in One,
Laud, honor, might and glory be
From age to age eternally.
Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui sanctam Vírginem Francíscam Xavériam, Sacratíssimi Cordis tui igne succénsam, per amplíssimas mundi plagas ad ánimas tibi lucrándas deduxísti, et per eam novam in Ecclésia tua Vírginum famíliam suscitásti; quǽsumus; ut ipsa intercedénte, ejúsdem Cordis tui virtútibus induámur, atque ad ætérnum beatitúdinis portum perveníre mereámur.
Oratio.eng: O Lord Jesus Christ, who, to win souls for yourself, led your holy virgin Frances, burning with love for your most Sacred Heart, on many journeys throughout the world, and through her raised up a new family of Virgins within your Church, grant, we beseech you, that by her intercession we may put on the virtues of that same Heart and be found worthy to reach the eternal haven of happiness.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, in Ecclésia tua Spíritum, quo replétus beátus Jósaphat Martyr et Póntifex tuus ánimam suam pro óvibus pósuit: ut, eo intercedénte, nos quoque eódem Spíritu moti ac roboráti, ánimam nostram pro frátribus pónere non vereámur.
Oratio.eng: Stir up in thy Church, we beseech thee, O Lord, that Spirit which so filled blessed Josaphat, thy Martyr and Bishop, that he laid down his life for his flock; that by his intercession we, being likewise animated and strengthened by that same Spirit, may not fear to lay down our lives for our brethren.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui beátum Albértum Pontíficem tuum atque Doctórem in humána sapiéntia divínæ fídei subiciénda magnum effecísti: da nobis, quǽsumus; ita ejus magistérii inhærére vestígiis, ut luce perfécta fruámur in cælis.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who made blessed Albert, thy Bishop and Doctor, eminent in the submission of human wisdom to divine faith, grant us, we beseech thee, so to follow the path of his teaching, that we may enjoy perfect light in heaven.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui in corde beátæ Gertrúdis Vírginis jucúndam tibi mansiónem præparásti: ipsíus méritis et intercessióne; cordis nostri máculas cleménter abstérge, et ejúsdem tríbue gaudére consórtio.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who didst make unto thyself a pleasant dwelling-place in the heart of thy blessed hand-maiden Gertrude, be Thou entreated for the same thy servant's sake, and by her prayers, to purge away in thy mercy all defilement from our hearts, and to grant us one day to rejoice with her in thy presence.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Laudémus Deum nostrum * In confessióne beátæ Elísabeth.
Invit.eng: For the confession of Blessed Elisabeth * let us praise our God.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Tuórum corda fidélium, Deus miserátor, illústra: et, beátæ Elísabeth précibus gloriósis; fac nos próspera mundi despícere, et cælésti semper consolatióne gaudére.
Oratio.eng: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of thy faithful people, and by the glorious prayers of thy blessed handmaid Elizabeth, make us to set little store by the good things of this world, and to rejoice ever in thy heavenly comfort.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui beátum Felícem Confessórem tuum ex erémo ad munus rediméndi captívos cǽlitus vocáre dignátus es: præsta, quǽsumus; ut per grátiam tuam ex peccatórum nostrórum captivitáte, ejus intercessióne, liberáti, ad cæléstem pátriam perducámur.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who by a sign from heaven didst call thy blessed Confessor Felix out of the desert to become a redeemer of bondsmen, grant, we beseech thee, unto his prayers, that thy grace may deliver us from the bondage of sin, and bring us home unto our very fatherland, which is in heaven.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Beáta es, * María, quæ credidísti: perficiéntur in te, quæ dicta sunt tibi a Dómino, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: O Mary * blessed art thou that didst believe! for there shall be a performance of those things which were told thee from the Lord. Alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ, alleluia.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, Spíritus Sancti habitáculum, hodiérna die in templo præsentári voluísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, ejus intercessióne, in templo glóriæ tuæ præsentári mereámur.
Oratio.eng: O God, Who wast pleased that the blessed Mary always a Virgin, being herself the dwelling-place of the Holy Ghost, should, as on this day, be presented in thine earthly Temple, grant, we beseech thee, that by her prayers we may worthily be presented in the heavenly Temple of thy glory.
